modules.name: Non-Functional Requirements
modules.description: Testable quality targets for speed, uptime, growth, data separation, security, backup, devices, language, weak network, files and records.

requirements.title: Screen load under 3 seconds on 4G
requirements.description: Screens must load in under 3 seconds on 4G (NFR-01).

requirements.title: OTP delivery within 30 seconds
requirements.description: OTP must be delivered within 30 seconds (NFR-02).

requirements.title: Visitor search result under 2 seconds
requirements.description: Visitor search must return a result in under 2 seconds (NFR-03).

requirements.title: 99.5% monthly availability
requirements.description: The system must be available 99.5% per month (NFR-04).

requirements.title: Support growth in projects and users
requirements.description: The system must handle 50+ projects, 25,000 users and 1,000 users at the same time (NFR-05).

requirements.title: Admin login with password and OTP
requirements.description: Admin login on the Web Panel must use password plus OTP (NFR-07).

requirements.title: Encrypt data in transfer and storage
requirements.description: Data must be encrypted in transfer and in storage (NFR-08).

requirements.title: Daily backup and recovery targets
requirements.description: Daily backup; restore within 4 hours; at most 1 hour of data lost (NFR-10).

requirements.title: Supported devices and browsers
requirements.description: Support Android 9+, iOS 14+, Chrome, Edge and Safari (NFR-11).

requirements.title: App languages: English, Gujarati, Hindi
requirements.description: The app must be available in English, Gujarati and Hindi (NFR-12).

requirements.title: Offline visitor entry
requirements.description: Up to 50 visitor entries are saved on the phone and sent when the network returns (NFR-13).

requirements.title: Live facility count refresh within 30 seconds
requirements.description: The live facility count must refresh within 30 seconds (NFR-17).

requirements.title: Configurable projects, buildings, floors, flats, amenities
requirements.description: Their numbers are not fixed; Raghuvir Admin adds them as needed with no code change (NFR-18).

rules.title: Project data separation
rules.description: No user sees another project's data; checked on the server for every request and tested every release (NFR-06).

rules.title: Session timeouts
rules.description: Mobile logs out after 30 days unused; Web after 30 minutes unused (NFR-09).

rules.title: File size limits
rules.description: Maximum 5 MB per photo and 10 MB per document (NFR-14).

rules.title: Activity log retention
rules.description: Activity log is kept at least 3 years (NFR-15).

rules.title: Complaint history retention
rules.description: Complaint history is kept at least for the 5-year defect responsibility period (NFR-16).

rules.title: Link to compliance rules
rules.description: NFR-06, 08, 15 and 16 link to the compliance rules in Section 19.
